title: Transfection Protocol for Human Umbilical Vein Endothelial Cells \( HUVEC) and Human Microvascular Endothelial Cells \( HMVEC )  in Targefect Handbook of Transfection Protocols
protocol: Seed endothelial cells so that they are approximately 70% confluent at the time of experiment.
Prepare complexes for transfection using Targefect-HUVEC reagent and Virofect enhancer in media containing at least 10% serum.
Perform transfection by adding prepared complexes to cells in the presence of serum.
Gently mix the Targefect-F2 solution upon receipt if it has frozen during shipping.
Store the Targefect-F-2 reagent at 4°C.
Avoid vortexing the Targefect-HUVEC reagent.
Store the Peptide Enhancer at 4°C.
Store the Virofect Enhancer at -20°C or -70°C.
Add Targefect to the mixture and mix well by flicking the tube.
Incubate the tubes at 37°C for 25 minutes to form transfection complexes.
Aspirate cell culture media completely from the dish.
Add transfection complexes to the cells, ensuring they cover the cells sufficiently for a 3-hour incubation period.
Swirl the dish gently to mix transfection complexes with the cell culture medium.
Incubate overnight at 37°C.
Assay for gene expression 24-48 hours after transfection.
Incubate cells with transfection complexes at 37°C for 3 hours.
Aspirate complexes and add complete media with at least 10% serum.
Replace the media with fresh complete media the next morning.
Assay at 36-48 hours post-transfection.

Culture bovine lung microvessel endothelial cells \(BLMVEC) from passage 4 in DMEM supplemented with 20% fetal bovine serum, 15 μg/ml endothelial cell growth supplement, and 1% nonessential amino acids.
Maintain BLMVEC in 5% CO2 + humidified air at 37°C until confluent pulmonary microvessel endothelial cell monolayer \(PMEM) is reached within 2–3 population doublings, taking 3–4 days.
Form transfection complex by adding Targefect F2 and Virofect to serum-free DMEM with enhanced yellow fluorescent protein \(EYFP-beta-actin) plasmids.
Measure transfection efficiency similar among groups such as in the wild-type EYFP-beta-actin (78.0% ± 0.02%) and the mutant Y198F isoform (79.9% ± 0.06%).
Formulate the volume of reagents to achieve a final ratio of 1 µg of DNA to 2 µl of Targefect F2 and 5 µl/ml Virofect, providing treatment concentrations of 0.25–0.35 µg of DNA/ml of media.
Incubate complexes in 5% CO2 + humidified air at 37°C for 25 min.
Add the complexes to subconfluent PMEM.
Remove complex and media after 2 h, replace with normal growth medium.
Incubate cells for 24 h until confluent.
Plate BLMVEC (0.7 x 10^5 cells in 0.5 ml DMEM) on collagen-coated Transwell-COL permeable supports (12 mm diameter, 0.4 μm pore size).
Incubate the cells for 24 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Transfect the cells by adding 500 μl of transfection complex to the top well (i.e., luminal) and 1.5 ml of serum-free DMEM to the bottom well (i.e., abluminal).
